notes.title: Very early alpha release of the rebuild
notes.content:
I wanted to release the progress I have made so far with the rebuild. Progress hasn't been as quick as I had hoped, so I am releasing this proof of concept to get feedback to see where I can focus my efforts.

When launching the game you should now have 3 options: The original version (2023), this alpha version of the rebuild (2025) and the tornado design tool.

I will create a video in the next few days explaining a bit more on how to use the editors in the alpha rebuild.

notes.content:
Just some minor updates to the tornado design tool:
[list]
[*] Added 'vertical motion' control slider to create upwards motion in the funnel
[*] Replaced red/green/blue sliders with hue/saturation/brightness sliders for easier control of the tornado funnel colouring
[/list]

notes.content:
I am still working on updated version of this game, essentially rebuilding from scratch. One thing that is getting completely revamped is tornado rendering. For this I have created the "Tornado Design Tool" - it isn't integrated into the gameplay yet, but I thought people could have a lot of fun with it while awaiting the next update.

To access the tool:
[olist]
[*] Right click on "Tornado: Research and Rescue" in steam -> Manage -> Browse local files
[*] Open the folder "Tornado Design Tool"
[*] Double click "Tornado Design Tool.exe"
[/olist]

To exit the tool, just use the alt-F4 keyboard shortcut.

Have fun! I love seeing the designs that people come up with, feel free to share on the discord or on the community forum :)

notes.title: Lots of Big Updates Coming!
notes.content:
Happy New Year everyone!

I am conscious there hasn't been an update on the game for a while, this has been for a few reasons:

[olist]
[*] I'm nearing the end of my PhD and I have been very busy getting the final draft of my thesis completed
[*] I had an idea for a completely different game, so I spent a couple of months creating a proof of concept in any free time I had ([url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yP65CcHXhhw]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yP65CcHXhhw[/url])
[*] The next updates planned are major updates
[/olist]

When working on the proof of concept game, I learned a lot about user interface design in Unity, so I am planning a complete revamp of the in-game user interface. This opens the option for more features, most notably a skill/upgrade tree. Here are the new features that are planned:

[h1]New Upgrade System, Research Contracts, New Data Types[/h1]
Right now the upgrade system is quite linear: you collect samples, sell them, then use the money to buy the next upgrade level(s). I plan to add a procedurally generated upgrade tree, with different requirements to unlock upgrades. At the start of the game, there will only be one or two easy to accomplish requirements, but as you progress there will be more requirements to fulfil that will require strategic chasing if you want to max out your upgrades. So what will these requirements be?


[list]
[*] Collect "X" samples of data type "Y" for tornado rating "Z"
[*] Take "X" photos of a tornado rated "Z"
[*] Save "X" lives
[*] Discover "X" anomalies of data type "Y" for tornado rating "Z"
[/list]

These requirements can be relaxed, for example you may only have to collect "X" number of samples of any data type, or for any tornado rating. So what do I mean by "data type" and "anomalies"?

[h2]New Data Types[/h2]
Currently the game only has one data type (wind speed), however there's no reason to be limited to this one type (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G0u5-HzXFVg&t=95s) (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PFxsE2RWgT8&t=24s). I plan to add a dial on the probe that you have to turn to the data type you want to collect, there may also be a short-ish setup sequence where you have to flip some switches and press some buttons, just to add to the tension! (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=03DdsuaKw1I&t=81s)

The new data types will be: wind speed, pressure, temperature and dew point temperature.

[h2]Data Anomalies[/h2]
There are already models of tornado wind fields, however, it's when models disagree with observed data (i.e. "anomalies") that science is pushed forward. You will be able to scan your collected samples for anomalies, these will be relatively rare, but when found will allow you to unlock upgrades and complete research contracts.

[h2]Research Contracts[/h2]
For those of you that played very early versions of this game, you may remember "contracts". These were time limited and generally people found them frustrating so I removed them. I plan to re-introduce them, but with no time limit. The contracts will have requirements just like for upgrades, and will range from short-term easy contracts that pay less to long-term difficult contracts that have a large pay-out. You will be able to take on multiple contracts (but limited to maybe 2-3, I will have to play test to see how well balanced this is), and you can cancel them but that will come with a penalty.

[h1]New Engine Sounds[/h1]
I am aware that the current engine sound effect is not the best, however I have purchased a realistic engine sound asset and plan to add a 2.5 litre diesel engine sound effect (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=liaan7FNWN8&t=1510s)

[h1]Complete Map Revamp[/h1]
I have started re-creating the map from scratch. This includes updated terrain texturing, advanced rendering using the newly released TerraFormer shader, and procedural placing of vegetation using TerraWorld2023. I am also manually creating the entire road network: the current road network in the game was automatically imported using OSM data, however the roads were not always placed correctly, and there are a LOT of missing roads and dirt roads. Getting around the map will be a lot easier now. This will take a while to do manually as the map is 100 square miles, but it will be worth it for a better overall map.

One fun change I plan on making is for some of the bridges crossing the main river in the game, they will be "under construction", requiring you to take a leap of faith. I have also surrounded the map with hills and there will be an invisible barrier around the perimeter, so no more falling into the abyss!

[h2]Performance Upgrades[/h2]
I have also purchased World Streamer 2 - right now the entire map is loaded into memory, so even if you can't see distant towns, all the models are loaded into memory, and if the town is hit by a tornado your CPU is simulating all the physics and mesh breaking even though you can't see it. What World Streamer 2 will allow me to do is break the map up into a grid, and only load in the models of objects you are near, with lower quality models being loaded for more distant models. This should reduce memory requirements and also improve performance.

Speaking of performance, I have switched to the "Universal Render Pipeline" (or URP), this allows for more post-processing effects but more importantly results in better performance for lower end devices.

[h2]New Houses, and Corn![/h2]
I have purchased a modular house system for Unity, so the house models will be getting upgraded. I have also purchased some farm assets including corn - which I think is mandatory considering this map is based on Pilot Mound, Iowa.

[h1]New Weather Engine[/h1]
The current weather engine was a great asset, however now that I've switched to URP I would be limited to Unity 2021, which wouldn't allow me to use future versions or the upgraded terrain shaders. I have switched to a new one, and while I've only tested it out for a few hours, it looks amazing, especially the lightning effects. The clouds are also physically *in* the scene, which means I should be able to blend the tornado with the clouds.

notes.title: Mouse Sensitivity Patch + FPS Limiter
notes.content:
I have adjusted the mouse settings to use raw mouse input, this has resulted in having to re-scale the sensitivity settings so you may need to adjust your player and vehicle sensitivity settings. 

I'm hoping this fixes issues people have been having with the mouse input, if not let me know which issues you are having and whether it is with the vehicle camera, first person camera, or both.

I have also added an FPS limiter, if you have high-end hardware and your GPU has been running hot, try setting the FPS limit and see if that lets your GPU run cooler.

notes.title: Improved Camera System, Probe Battery Introduced & More Settings
notes.content:
It's been a while since the last update! New in this one:

[list]
[*] Improved camera/rendering system - this should prevent vegetation suddenly disappearing when outside of the vehicle and using the pause screen. Ghosting/aliasing artefacts are reduced as well (they still show up in certain situations, but visually they are massively reduced)
[*] Probe battery - the probe now has a battery that will slowly discharge once deployed. When the battery runs out the probe stops sampling. To recharge put the probe back in the truck. Both the battery capacity and recharge time can be upgraded.
[*] Main menu bugfix - after returning to the main menu there was a bug preventing loading back into the game (stuck with a random view of the terrain), this should now be fixed
[*] New settings: MSAA level (this was previously automatically set to 8x, it now defaults to 2x and should result in an FPS increase), screen/window resolution, texture resolution (defaults to full resolution but can be set to 1/2, 1/4 or even 1/8 resolution to improve performance)
[/list]

notes.title: Small patches: tornado and vehicle camera bug fixes
notes.content:
- Adjusted some of the sensitivity settings for the tornado camera
- Fixed issue with vehicle camera not rotating correctly with vehicle movement

notes.title: 🔥🌪️ Unleash the Storm: The Game-Changing Update You've Been Waiting For! 🌪️🔥
notes.content:
Attention, storm chasers! We've got an update that's more than just a few tweaks. We've carefully reworked and enhanced key elements of the game to bring you a richer experience. Here's what's new:

🌀 Become the Tornado in [b]Be The Tornado Mode[/b] 🌀
Start as a mere F1, a whisper in the wind. But wreak havoc, and evolve into an awe-inspiring F5 wedge tornado! Your path of destruction just got a whole lot more personal.

💥 Next-Level Destruction System 💥
We didn't just tweak the destruction; we overhauled it! Now, not only is the destruction procedural, but it's also a visual spectacle! Customize the chaos with settings for destructible buildings and debris generation. And watch out—powerlines now topple over, blocking your escape routes!

🌳 Random Object Scattering: It's a Jungle Out There! 🌳
From wind turbines (whose blades detach in high winds, so beware!) to tractors, trailers, hay bales, and uprootable trees—every game will be a new adventure!

🚚 Upgrade Smart, Not Hard: Choose Your Style 🚚
You can't max out everything anymore. With limitations on truck, probe, and radar upgrades, you'll have to strategize. But don't worry; there are still 30,000 ways to become the ultimate storm chaser!

📊 Revamped HUD: Information at a Glance 📊
Say goodbye to plain white text! Your HUD now features mini "data screens" for sample data and interceptometer readings. It's not just informative; it's immersive!

🎮 Fine-Tuned Sensitivity Settings 🎮
We've expanded the range for both first-person and in-vehicle camera adjustments. Tailor your experience to the finest detail!

So, what are you waiting for? Dive into this whirlwind of upgrades and experience storm chasing like never before! 🌪️💥

notes.title: Ambient Sound Effects, Debris Cloud Improvements, Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] You will now hear birds during the day and crickets at night, which will fade out as night falls
[*] You will also hear frogs and water near the river
[*] The appearance of the debris cloud is more variable, it can be smooth or bumpy
[*] Fixed issue with pause menu becoming disabled

notes.title: Teleportation Bug Fix
notes.content: Stops player randomly teleporting when exiting vehicle

notes.title: Updated Sound Effects, More Mouse Sensitivity Settings, Minor Patches
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Sound effects have been updated to be more intimidating, you will also notice a difference in sound when getting in/out of the truck

New in this patch:

notes.title: Partial Controller Support, Updated Funnel & Debris Cloud Rendering
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Had a Bob Ross Moment ("Happy Little Accident") and stumbled on a better way to render debris clouds:
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1005462599544078426/1141350449929265323/image.png[/img]

[h1]Vehicle Controls[/h1]

Press Button - 'A' / South Button

Move - Left Stick
Sprint - Click and move left stick

notes.title: VHS Camera Upgrades & Ultrawide fix
notes.content:
You will now have to upgrade your VHS camera, it will start out very grainy with all sorts of tracking and tape artifacts. You can upgrade tape quality, sensor, tracking etc. to get a clearer image.

I have also changed the ultrawide support so that the UI scales vertically instead of horizontally, making it compatible with extremely wide aspect ratio monitors.

notes.title: Ultra-wide Support, Fixed Parking Brake & UI Glitches, Updated Lighting
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Support has now been added for ultra-wide monitors, please let me know if you notice any UI issues if you use an ultra-wide
[*] Fixed issue with parking brake not applying
[*] Fixed UI glitches where buttons would "float" out of the screen
[*] Updated lighting so the stratus clouds don't absorb too much light
[/list]

notes.title: Visual Fixes & Vehicle Handling
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Vehicle handling updated so truck doesn't skid out of control when braking and turning
[*] Adjusted wind effects so vegetation doesn't get stretched to ridiculous proportions
[*] Cloud layer fades in/out depending on proximity to cell
[*] Tweaked VHS effect to have more "washed out" colouring
[*] Fixed some issues with post processing on laptop screen
[/list]

notes.title: UI Overhaul, River Overhaul, VHS Overhaul, Updated Terrain Texturing
notes.content:
[list]
[*] This update completely removes the DOS/Ceefax style user interface in the laptop, and replaces it with a more era-accurate "Motif" user interface with a point-and-click interface (no more keyboard shortcuts!) - there is also a "Dark Mode" toggle for those of you who prefer it :)
[*] The horrendous screen shaking while the laptop is in full screen mode has also been fixed!
[*] I have replaced the river with a much more detailed river material with reflections, ripples, rocks etc.
[*] A completely different asset is now used for rendering VHS effects.
[*] Terrain texturing has been updated, I'm not sure how noticeable it is, but hopefully it looks less "uniform" than before.
[/list]

notes.title: Fixed Timezone Issue, Lowered Stratford Siren, Brightened Post-Processing
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed the timezone-offset issue where the game wouldn't start at the user's inputted time, but would be offset by their timezone
[*] Lowered the siren in Stratford now that the terrain is lowered
[*] Brightened the post-processing by 0.5EV to help with night-time driving
[/list]

notes.title: Building Placement, Updated Wind FX, Lighting HotFix
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Smoothed terrain around towns, hopefully no more "floating buildings"
[*] Smoother transition for wind effects on vegetation and trees, hopefully no more "jumping/skipping" every second
[*] Fixed issue with reflection probe on truck affecting roads
[*] Temporarily removed AI traffic, will be re-introduced in a coming update
[/list]

notes.title: Roads & Visuals Update
notes.content: I've manually adjusted all of the roads so that there are no longer "cliffs" on each side. I've also adjusted the lighting and visuals to try and give the game a bit more of a polished look.

notes.title: Simfest 2023 begins today and Tornado: Research and Rescue is part of it!
notes.content:
I am thrilled to announce that Tornado: Research and Rescue will be part of Simfest – the Steam festival celebrating all things related to simulation games. 
From today through the 24th of July, 10am PDT 2023, you can save 30% off Tornado: Research and Rescue. In addition to that, you will also be able to experience some of the latest and greatest simulation titles and see what the future holds for the simulation genre with coming soon games. From simulators which cover hobbies you would love to experience to job simulators which revolve around your dream career (even out of this world ones), Simfest will feature a wide variety of titles in the genre.
Simfest is a Steam festival co-hosted by Auroch Digital and Stray Fawn Studio. This year’s event will be the second Simfest, after Simfest: Hobby Edition took place in 2022. 
Join Tornado: Research and Rescue, and many other incredible simulation games in Simfest 2023. I hope to see you there!

notes.title: Vegetation LOD Hotfix
notes.content: The vegetation render radius setting was broken, this will allow players to customise the render distance of vegetation and trees.

notes.title: Tutorial hotfix
notes.content: An eagle-eyed player spotted a bug with the tutorial, which I'm happy to say is now fixed :)

notes.title: Steam Workshop Support Added!
notes.content:
Steam workshop support is now added!

You can now subscribe to files in the Steam Workshop and they will be automatically downloaded next time you start the game. You can then select your truck from the menu screen.

notes.title: Hot Fix - HUD and Clouds
notes.content:
Tornadoes were becoming detached from their parent clouds, that has been fixed (or hopefully at least less likely to occur!)

Also fixed issue with HUD not clearing after a market spike.

notes.title: Status Scroller + New Settings + Deviant Motion
notes.content:
New Feature - Status Updates: Notifications will be shown in the bottom-right of the HUD showing how many samples you've collected, how many residents have been saved in each town, and how many have died.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/02zKCPW/image.png[/img]

New Settings - Cell Growth Time: Change how long you have to wait for cells to grow and produce a tornado. Options are: Very Slow, Slow, Normal, Fast and Very Fast.
Forecast Mode: Setting this to 'Random' will result in the forecast changing randomly every 15 minutes, otherwise you can override it to 'Low', 'Moderate', 'High' risk or even 'Outbreak'

Changes: Tornado spawn % and cell cycling % settings have been removed, these are now controlled via the new forecast mode setting.
Tornadoes can now have deviant motion, they no longer follow a perfectly straight line.
'Wind mode' has been removed, random cell motion is no longer an option

notes.title: "Smooth" Tornadoes, Precipitation Fix, Sound Fix, Input Fix
notes.content:
Fixed issues where the same key could trigger multiple actions, for example, pressing ENTER to save game also sounds siren, or dialling in a remote warning results in selling samples.

Fixed texture issue preventing rain shafts from rendering.

Tornadoes now start smooth with small debris clouds, over time the funnels become more "dirty" and the debris clouds grow

Moved truck audio source so it is now centred with the model instead of offset

notes.title: In-Game Tutorial & Lighting Tweak
notes.content:
Added an in-game tutorial new players can work through, teaching the main concepts of the game.

Softened shadows and changed lighting settings.

notes.title: Market Price Hotfix
notes.content: Market prices could go negative if you were particularly unlucky! All data prices now have a minimum of $1.

notes.title: Additional Settings + Hotfix
notes.content:
Two new settings were added:
[list]
[*] Tornado Quality - this changes the ray marching settings and can be used to gain extra performance
[*] Camera Shake - disable camera shake in first person view if preferred
[/list]

One adjustment was made :- AI traffic should get tossed by tornadic winds

Fixed bug where player wouldn't die unless market screen was open

notes.title: Hotfix - Tornado-Vehicle Interaction
notes.content: Fixed tornado winds not interacting with player vehicle

notes.title: Bug Fixes + AI Traffic
notes.content:
Added AI traffic around Stratford, I will add more AI routes over the next few days.

Fixed bug where main probe wasn't collecting samples

Adjusted the rain wrapping, may still need adjusting but it looked good in the editor

notes.title: Core Gameplay Update - Data Market & Moddable Vehicles
notes.content:
The major updates are:
[list]
[*] Modding support for vehicles and probes
[*] Data Market replaced mission system
[/list]
Now you can deploy your probe whenever you like and collect as many samples as you like (no missions or upgrades required!) - time the markets and sell your data for massive profits! If you're lucky you will sell during a market spike!

I have also submitted an official quick start guide for the game, that should appear on the game's "Guides" page soon.

If you are feeling ambitious you can add your own vehicle and probe models to the game. A template Unity project package is included in the game folder. I have created a video guide here: 

[previewyoutube=fnXeAO84zvQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Minor updates:
[list]
[*] Fixed radar lag-spike
[*] Added V-Sync option
[*] Added precipitation particle system
[/list]

notes.title: Forecast Mode HotFIx
notes.content:
Major Change: risk area is now shown in red on the map, rather than a text description on the forecast page. Size of risk area can also change.

Minor changes:
Fixed graphical error where opening and closing laptop caused the radar and forecast screens to glitch together
Fixed tornado spawn intensities so they are always at least F1 strength

notes.title: Forecast Mode!
notes.content:
Major Change:

When playing with winds set to "realistic" the laptop will also have a daily forecast page. This is the outlook for the day and will give you an overall severe rating (low / moderate / high / outbreak), wind direction, probability of cells spawning tornadoes, probabilities of cells cycling, probabilities for each type of F-rating being produced and a list of town in the areas where cells will spawn. This will override any spawn/cycling % in the settings screen.

Minor changes:
Tornado winds no longer interact with the car when the player is outside of it - I tested it and just spent 15 minutes walking around looking for my car. While realistic it just seemed a bit... boring.

Possibly fixed the issue where external peripherals like joysticks and steering wheels cause the truck to perform all sorts of weird manoeuvres (still waiting on confirmation for this).

notes.title: Hot Fix - Minor Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Disabled radar screen and replaced with BSOD for performance in doomsday mode
[*] Truck lights should actually light up now
[*] Truck should actually respond to tornadic winds now even if unoccupied
[*] Fixed potential bug where if you run away and your truck impacts something you would still die
[*] Other minor bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Photography, Remote Warnings and More!
notes.content:
Major changes:

[list]
[*] You can take up to 3 photographs per tornado, closer photos of more intense tornadoes results in higher pay. The amount earned per photograph decreases, so take your shots wisely!
[*] You can now remotely "dial-in" to sound the siren in a town, the first call costs $1000, the second costs $5000 and every subsequent call costs $10000
[*] Doomsday gamemode has been added: you start with one tornado on the map that always follows you, every 30 seconds another tornado spawns - how many rounds can you survive?
[*] Realistic wind direction is now an option - cells will spawn in the south west corner of the map and move generally NE with the mean wind, right-moving cells generally produce stronger tornadoes
[/list]


Minor changes:
[list]
[*] There is a random offset when you reset your vehicle to help with situations where you are stuck
[*] EAS tones have been replaced
[*] Jumping now works (space)
[*] Mouse remaining visible after applying settings has been fixed
[*] Truck now reacts to tornadoes even if you aren't inside of it
[*] A few fences have been added to the map, more to come
[*] Distance from probe display has been fixed
[*] Floating sirens have been fixed
[/list]

notes.title: Tornado Magnet Mode + Options, Options, Options!
notes.content:
You can now configure your game with two different game modes:
[list]
[*] Career - Normal game mode
[*] Tornado Magnet - All tornadoes move towards your location, constantly, unceasingly, mercilessly
[/list]

There are also three "death modes":
[list]
[*] Disabled - You can't die
[*] Tornado Only - You only die if your character or truck is lifted above 700 metres in the air
[*] Enabled - You die if you are lifted by a tornado or if your truck impacts something
[/list]

And you can set the date and time before you start, format is MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS

[h1]IMPORTANT[/h1]
Please be respectful of historical event dates, while they are well known within the storm chasing community, these are also dates where families lost loved ones, their homes, their livelihoods etc. If I start seeing videos of people glorifying death and destruction on these dates I will remove this feature.

An additional option has been added for vegetation render distance, turn this down if the new map is making your game lag.

I also fixed a bug where switching to the laptop while in VHS camera mode caused some rendering glitches, you will now have to exit camera mode to enter the laptop mode. The vehicle tyre friction has been increased to decrease the amount of screeching.

notes.title: Cyclic Storms & Setting Explanations
notes.content:
Storms can now cycle and put down multiple tornadoes!

Also you can hover your mouse over each setting on the settings screen for an explanation of what each does, and a recommendation for default settings.

notes.title: Lighting & Sky Fix + Tornado Probabilities
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The "# Tornadoes" setting is now "# Cells", and you can adjust the probability of a cell producing a tornado using the "Tornado Spawn %" setting.
[*] Fixed "blue sky tornadoes" and made the game a bit more overcast again
[*] Fixed ambient lighting so shadows aren't as harsh
[/list]

notes.title: Map Overhaul - Step 2 (of many)
notes.content: Added more detail to the map, enjoy! :)

notes.title: Map Overhaul - Step 1 of Many!
notes.content:
The main update with this build is a map overhaul:

The map has been re-textured and the heightmap has been updated to the real-world location (Pilot Mound, Iowa). Tree distributions have changed to be more dense near rivers and less dense on the "plains".

I still need to manually adjust the road network, however this is a several hour job I have to do by hand, and didn't want to delay the update for this. I will make incremental updates to both the road network and the map in future map overhaul updates.

Other updates:
[list]
[*] Fixed tornado upward motion, it was way too strong, and is now a percentage of the rotation speed
[*] Previous update broke the car-tornado interaction, this is now fixed, and is also tweaked to be a bit stronger than before, so be careful at close range!
[*] Volume slider added on settings screen (press 'esc' to access)
[*] Visible gap between clouds and tornadoes should be fixed (let me know if this persists)
[*] Probe no longer wastes samples, will only take a reading when it is within the active mission rating range
[*] Car has stronger brakes
[*] Road and terrain have different physics materials, car handling differs between surfaces you're driving on
[*] The intercept point is now visible and highlighted in-game, so you can simply drive towards it for a good intercept (can be disabled on the settings screen)
[*] Garbled siren sound has been fixed (doppler effect disabled)
[/list]

Enjoy and have fun!

notes.title: Vehicle Physics HotFix
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Enabled brake assist (prevents vehicle going out of control when braking)
[*] Enabled traction control (prevents horrible screeching when accelerating)
[*] Increased tyre friction (better handling, acceleration and braking)
[*] Tightened the anti-roll (no more excessive swaying when cornering)
[*] Added textures to laptop model
[*] Vehicle can now collide with bridges and other road objects
[/list]

notes.title: Vehicle Physics Overhaul + Gameplay Tweaks
notes.content:
The following have changed:

[list]
[*] Old vehicle physics have been completely removed from the game and replaced with much more stable vehicle physics
[*] You can now switch between driver view and 3rd person view in the vehicle by pressing the C key
[*] You can zoom in and out with the VHS camera by using the mouse scroll wheel
[*] Tornado ground speeds have changed, they are slower to make intercepting easier
[*] You will now see the distance you are from your probe underneath your probe readings display (useful if you manage to lose your probe!)
[*] Timings have been adjusted to make things a little bit less chaotic
[*] A bit more work has been done on the tornado funnel blending, it is by no means complete, but hopefully looks a bit better than the previous version
[/list]

notes.title: Hot FIx #3 - Mouse on Death Screen Fixed!
notes.content: Enabled the mouse on the "Death Screen"

notes.title: Hot Fix #2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Mouse cursor is only visible on settings screen (opened with 'esc' key)
[*] Can toggle between windowed and full screen mode
[*] EAS tone has been pitch-shifted and made quieter
[*] Cells forming near the edge of the map will move towards the centre of the map, no more "waste of time" cells
[*] Vehicle can only be reset every 5 seconds, must be moving slowly or stationary to reset
[/list]

notes.content:

[*]Photos will be saved to your "My Documents/Tornado Research and Rescue" directory
[*]Fixed sliding truck when standing next to it
[*]Removed a tree that was in the middle of the road
[*]Added label for Stratford to the map
[/list]

notes.title: Game is Released!
notes.content: The time is finally here! I aim to be a very active developer, so please report any bugs you spot and I will be pushing hot fixes throughout the day!
